summary.text: Evan Shanley is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 24 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Shanley chaired the State Government and Elections Committee and was also assigned to the Innovation, Internet and Technology Committee, the Municipal Government Committee and the House Rules Committee.
